import mmap,struct,gzip,json,collections
f=open('hg38.2bit','rb');m=mmap.mmap(f.fileno(),0,access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
endian='>' if m[:4]==bytes.fromhex('1a412743') else '<'
def u32(p):return struct.unpack_from(endian+'I',m,p)[0]
n=u32(8);p=16;index=[]
for i in range(n):
 l=m[p];p+=1;name=m[p:p+l].decode();p+=l;off=u32(p);p+=4;index.append((name,off))
info=[]
for name,off in index:
 length=u32(off);p=off+4;nn=u32(p);p+=4;nstarts=[u32(p+i*4) for i in range(nn)];p+=4*nn;nsizes=[u32(p+i*4) for i in range(nn)];p+=4*nn;nm=u32(p);p+=4+8*nm+4
 info.append((name,p,length,nstarts,nsizes))
print('Sequences',len(info),flush=True)
enc={'T':0,'C':1,'A':2,'G':3}
def packed(s):
 out=[]
 for i in range(0,len(s),4):
  v=0
  for b in s[i:i+4]:v=(v<<2)|enc[b]
  out.append(v)
 return bytes(out)
hits=[]
with gzip.open('identify.donor.R1.fq.gz','rt') as f:
 for i in range(12):
  name=f.readline().strip();s=f.readline().strip();f.readline();f.readline()
  for strand,seq in [('+',s),('-',s.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1])]:
   for shift in range(4):
    sub=seq[40+shift:72+shift]
    if any(b not in enc for b in sub):continue
    pat=packed(sub);start=0
    while True:
     h=m.find(pat,start)
     if h<0:break
     start=h+1
     for chrom,beg,length,_,_ in info:
      if beg<=h<beg+(length+3)//4:
       pos=(h-beg)*4-40-shift
       hits.append((name,chrom,pos,strand));print(hits[-1],flush=True);break
counts=collections.Counter(x[1] for x in hits);chrom=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
positions=[x[2] for x in hits if x[1]==chrom]
start=max(0,min(positions)-1000000);end=max(positions)+1000000
name,beg,length,ns,nl=next(x for x in info if x[0]==chrom);end=min(end,length)
table=[''.join('TCAG'[(v>>shift)&3] for shift in (6,4,2,0)) for v in range(256)]
dna=''.join(table[v] for v in m[beg+start//4:beg+(end+3)//4])[start%4:start%4+end-start]
a=bytearray(dna.encode())
for p,l in zip(ns,nl):
 lo=max(start,p);hi=min(end,p+l)
 if hi>lo:a[lo-start:hi-start]=b'N'*(hi-lo)
with open('region.fa','w') as out:
 out.write('>'+chrom+'\\n')
 for i in range(0,len(a),60):out.write(a[i:i+60].decode()+'\\n')
json.dump({'chrom':chrom,'start':start,'end':end,'hits':hits},open('region.json','w'),indent=2)
print('REGION',chrom,start,end,flush=True)
PY"

import pysam,numpy as np,json,collections
r=json.load(open('region.json'));offset=r['start'];chrom=r['chrom']
vf=pysam.VariantFile('panel.bcf');samples=list(vf.header.samples)
print('Panel samples',len(samples),flush=True)
sites={}
for v in vf:
 if len(v.ref)"'!=1 or not v.alts or len(v.alts)!=1 or len(v.alts[0])!=1:continue
 af=v.info.get('"'AF',None)
 if af is not None:
  af=af[0] if isinstance(af,tuple) else af
  if not 0.02<af<0.98:continue
 gt=np.fromiter((sum(c['GT']) if None not in c['GT'] else -1 for c in v.samples.values()),dtype=np.int8,count=len(samples))
 if not .02<gt[gt>=0].mean()/2<.98:continue
 sites[v.start-offset]=(v.ref,v.alts[0],gt,v.pos)
print('Informative SNPs',len(sites),flush=True)
bam=pysam.AlignmentFile('reads.bam','rb');score=np.zeros(len(samples));sq=np.zeros(len(samples));opp=np.zeros(len(samples),dtype=int);ns=0;nr=0;obs=[]
prob=np.array([0.005,0.5,0.995]);lp=np.log(prob);lq=np.log(1-prob)
for col in bam.pileup(chrom,min(sites),max(sites)+1,truncate=True,stepper='samtools',min_base_quality=20,min_mapping_quality=30,max_depth=500,ignore_overlaps=True):
 if col.reference_pos not in sites:continue
 ref,alt,gt,pos=sites[col.reference_pos]
 c=collections.Counter(p.alignment.query_sequence[p.query_position].upper() for p in col.pileups if not p.is_del and not p.is_refskip and p.query_position is not None)
 rc,ac=c[ref],c[alt];depth=rc+ac
 if depth<3 or depth>30 or depth/sum(c.values())<.9:continue
 good=gt>=0
 score[good]+=(rc*lq+ac*lp)[gt[good]]
 sq[good]+=(ac/depth-gt[good]/2)**2
 opp[good]+=((gt[good]==0)&(ac>=2)&(rc==0))|((gt[good]==2)&(rc>=2)&(ac==0))
 ns+=1;nr+=depth;obs.append((pos,ref,alt,rc,ac))
order=np.argsort(score)[::-1]
with open('donor_scores.tsv','w') as out:
 out.write('sample\\tlog_likelihood\\tsquared_error\\topposite_homozygous\\n')
 for i in order:out.write(f'{samples[i]}\\t{score[i]:.3f}\\t{sq[i]:.3f}\\t{opp[i]}\\n')
print('Scored SNPs',ns,'observations',nr,flush=True)
for i in order[:20]:print(samples[i],score[i],sq[i],opp[i],flush=True)
with open('snp_observations.tsv','w') as out:
 for x in obs:out.write('\\t'.join(map(str,x))+'\\n')
PY"
